item.text: The failure comes from `naturaldate` calculating “today” in the value’s timezone, then handing the value to `naturalday`, which recalculates “today” in the machine’s local timezone. I’m removing that second, inconsistent comparison and using the already computed date for both the relative label and formatted fallback.

Fixed `naturaldate` so it uses one timezone-aware “today” value for both the relative label and date formatting. The reported case now returns “today.”

The requested suite passes: **730 passed, 132 skipped, 2 deselected**. The change is in [time.py](C:/Users/Usuario/AppData/Local/Temp/pe2/work-a/b09-naturaldate-aware-today-luna-2/src/humanize/time.py:361).
